episode.title: He quit VC startups to go solo. Here is what worked (Guest Name)
episode.description:
He left a VC-backed startup, went solo, and grew a bootstrapped tool with zero ads. Here is how.

What we cover:
- Why he walked away from the VC startup world
- How an open-source README became the whole funnel
- The one thing to ship before you quit your job
- The 'roadmap of ghosts' mistake and how to avoid it

00:00 Cold open
00:05 Why he left
00:39 Open source as the funnel
01:35 The biggest mistake
02:30 Advice for founders who want out
